label: The upper confidence bound
subgoals: Compute mean plus kappa times standard deviation for each candidate
Pick the candidate with the largest score
Raise kappa to explore more and lower it to exploit

label: Expected improvement
subgoals: Standardize the gap between incumbent and mean by the standard deviation
Look up the normal distribution and density at that value
Combine the gap term and the uncertainty term

label: Exploit or explore
subgoals: Compute the expected improvement of each candidate
Pick the candidate with the larger value
Report the best evaluated point when the budget ends
